CREATE TABLE `app_settings` (`key` TEXT NOT NULL, `value` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`key`))

CREATE TABLE `automation_events` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `eventKey` TEXT NOT NULL, `sourcePackage` TEXT NOT NULL, `notificationKey` TEXT NOT NULL, `postedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `payloadHash` TEXT NOT NULL, `encryptedPayload` BLOB, `payloadIv` BLOB, `status` TEXT NOT NULL, `parser` TEXT, `providerReference` TEXT, `failureCode` TEXT, `parsedSummary` TEXT, `transactionId` TEXT, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `processedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE `budgets` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `categoryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `amountCents` INTEGER NOT NULL, `period` TEXT NOT NULL, `startDate` INTEGER NOT NULL, `alertThreshold` REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.8, `isActive` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE `categories` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `type` TEXT NOT NULL, `color` INTEGER NOT NULL, `includeInSpending` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `parentCategoryId` TEXT, `isBuiltIn` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `isActive` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))
CREATE TABLE `merchant_category_rules` (`merchantKey` TEXT NOT NULL, `merchantName` TEXT NOT NULL, `categoryId` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`merchantKey`))

CREATE TABLE `payment_methods` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `color` INTEGER NOT NULL, `isBuiltIn` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `isActive` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE `recurring_expenses` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `amountCents` INTEGER NOT NULL, `cycle` TEXT NOT NULL, `customDays` INTEGER, `anchorDate` INTEGER NOT NULL, `categoryId` TEXT, `paymentMethodId` TEXT, `endedAt` INTEGER, `isActive` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `note` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE `transactions` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `categoryId` TEXT, `paymentMethodId` TEXT, `amountCents` INTEGER NOT NULL, `type` TEXT NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `transactionDate` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `entryOrigin` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', `automationKind` TEXT, `sourceEventId` TEXT, `isUserEdited` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `merchantName` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))
